title: Skill Front Matter Validation
description: Use Pydantic to validate SKILL.md front matter, ensuring name matches folder and description meets length requirements.

steps.description: Purpose: P5 validates a skill's front matter using Pydantic.
Setup: writes the terse-helper skill file with front matter and rules.
Model definition: SkillFrontMatter with name pattern and description length constraints.
Load_skill: reads SKILL.md, splits front matter, validates with Pydantic, checks folder match.
Validation: loads skill, prints metadata and first body line, catches validation errors.
Error demonstration: hand-written front matter with invalid name and short description is refused.
